lines.text: In the fortieth year, Moses began to explain the law east of the Jordan in the land of Moab.
At Horeb the LORD said Israel had stayed long enough and told them to enter the land.
Moses said he could not carry the burden alone, because the LORD had made them as numerous as the sand.
Moses had the people choose wise men from each city and appointed them over thousands, hundreds, fifties, and tens.
Moses charged the judges to show no partiality and to bring any case too difficult for them to him.
